title: JWT claims JSON parsed per row in a policy
issue: USING (owner_id = (current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb ->> 'sub')::int) casts the ~2 KB claims string to jsonb for every row when no index lets the planner evaluate it once.
symptom: naive_rls: Seq Scan with the jsonb expression in Filter; time proportional to rows x claim size. Wrapping in (select ...) makes an InitPlan and is orders of magnitude faster; an index on owner_id also hides the problem (naive_indexed_rls control).

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents (~1000 per owner)

subjects.name: user1
subjects.note: owns ~1000 docs; request.jwt.claims has sub=1 (fixed via @set in the variants, so only one subject)
